body:
Update to golang.org/x/text@v0.39.0+ for https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5970

Update to golang.org/x/net@v0.55.0+ for https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5026

/kind bug
/sig architecture security

```release-note
Update golang.org/x/text and golang.org/x/net dependencies to include security updates
```

comments.body:
The new `golang.org/x` pulling in a minimum of Go 1.25 is making the go-compatibility test jobs (running with Go 1.24) unhappy, which we knew would happen eventually.

I'm glad these jobs make visible this impact, now we need to decide what to do with it.

If we have to choose between pulling in security fixes to 1.34 deps and preserving the ability to build with client-go 1.34 patch releases on a (now-unsupported) Go 1.24, I think we'd choose to bump our minimum Go. I'll open an update to test-infra to bump the go version for the go-compatibility jobs to 1.25 - https://github.com/kubernetes/test-infra/pull/37636
